{"answers":[{"question_id":"Q024_fibronectin_fragment_selection","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, both reference domains are in the Fibronectin type III family b.1.2.1, family SUNID 49266, within Fibronectin type III superfamily b.1.2, immunoglobulin-like beta-sandwich fold b.1, class b all-beta proteins. d1uc6a1 is 1uc6 A:6-109 from human ciliary neurotrophic factor receptor alpha and has no retrieved SCOPe fragment inconsistency; d1o5dt2 is 1o5d T:107-205 from the extracellular region of human tissue factor and has a domain-local `fr` annotation: \"fragment; missing more than one-third of the common structure and/or sequence\". The flag therefore does not move d1o5dt2 out of the family or weaken the SCOPe family-level homology assertion for the observed tissue-factor FnIII core, but it does make d1o5dt2 a partial exemplar. Align d1o5dt2 only over the residues/core it actually contains; do not pad it or use d1uc6a1 or another FnIII member to infer its absent strands, loops, exact boundaries, or missing structural states. For representative selection, prefer d1uc6a1 or another non-fragment domain when a complete b.1.2.1 representative is needed, and use d1o5dt2 only when a fragment is explicitly acceptable or biologically relevant. For interpreting family diversity, count tissue factor as a real Fibronectin type III-family member, but do not let the truncated entry exaggerate domain diversity, imply a new fold, or justify unsafe function transfer: CNTFR-alpha and tissue factor are different protein nodes, so shared b.1.2.1 membership supports homology of the FnIII domain core, not transfer of receptor/ligand function, chain coverage, or a full-length template between d1uc6a1 and d1o5dt2.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope.get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/current; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1uc6a1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1uc6a1/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1uc6a1/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1uc6a1/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1o5dt2; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1o5dt2/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1o5dt2/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1o5dt2/homology","mcp__scope.get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/current; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/b.1.2.1/parents"]}]}
